evidence.observation: Pressure stable at ~2.90 Torr through ramp and early growth at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure rose steadily 2.97→3.00→3.05→3.09→3.175 Torr from t=2760 to t=3240, and the rise is speeding up
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow change does not explain the pressure rise
Temperature held at 750 °C, heater power normal at ~44%
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; the growth atmosphere cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test (isolate the pump and watch pressure) would separate an exhaust blockage from a seal leak with air coming in; checking the exhaust line or pump conductance would confirm a blockage.
